title: IsItDown config.yml
description: The Light edition's configuration file. Secrets go in the environment and are referenced as ${VAR}.

pollIntervalMinutes.description: Minutes between polls of every provider, 1–1440. Default 3.

requestTimeoutSeconds.description: Timeout of each HTTP request in seconds, 1–120. Default 8.

maxRetries.description: Attempts per provider per cycle, with backoff, 1–10. Default 3.

failureThreshold.description: Consecutive failed cycles before one "monitoring degraded" warning, 1–100. Default 5.

adaptivePolling.description: Poll a provider with an open incident on adaptiveIntervalMinutes instead of its own cadence. Default true.

adaptiveIntervalMinutes.description: Cadence for a provider in trouble, 1–1440; never slower than its own. Default 1.

confirmSamples.description: Consecutive polls that must agree before a change notifies, 1–10. Default 1 (off).

correlationThreshold.description: Providers going bad inside correlationWindowMinutes before one shared-failure alert replaces their own. 0 or 1 is off (default).

correlationWindowMinutes.description: How wide the shared-failure window is, in minutes, 1–1440. Default 10.

locale.description: Language of notification messages: en, it, de, es, fr or pt. Default en.

id.description: Unique lowercase slug for this provider (letters, digits, dashes).

adapter.description: How the page is read: statuspage, rss, html, http, tcp, dns and others (see docs/configuration.md).

baseUrl.description: The status page or endpoint URL, http or https.

enabled.description: false keeps the entry but stops polling it. Default true.

group.description: Slug of the group this provider belongs to; routing can target group:<slug>.

dependsOn.description: Ids of providers this one runs on, named as the probable cause of a shared failure.

crossChecks.description: Probes and imap only: the provider (optionally provider#component) whose page this is a second opinion on.

intervalMinutes.description: This provider's own cadence, 1–1440; omit to follow pollIntervalMinutes.

intervalSeconds.description: Probes only: cadence in seconds, 10–3600. Never together with intervalMinutes.

options.description: Adapter-specific settings, as strings (see the adapter's section in docs/configuration.md).

mutedUntil.description: ISO 8601 UTC time until which this provider notifies nothing.

id.description: The component's id as the provider publishes it.

name.description: The component's name, shown where the provider's own is unavailable.

components.description: Components to watch, each with its id and name; empty watches the whole page.

scopeToComponents.description: true derives the provider's status from the selected components only. Default false.

favorite.description: Star the provider: listed first and always in the weekly summary.

outageCostPerHour.description: What an hour of outage costs you, as a bare number in your own currency.

authority.description: Override whether this source is declared (the provider's word) or observed (our own reading).

impact.description: What breaks when this provider does, one sentence carried into every message.

owner.description: Who answers for this provider, carried into every message.

runbook.description: What to do when it is down, in Markdown; linked from every message.

tags.description: Free lowercase labels; routing can target tag:<slug>.

from.description: Start of a one-off mute, ISO 8601 with offset.

until.description: End of a one-off mute, ISO 8601 with offset; after from.

days.description: Weekdays a weekly mute runs on: mon, tue, wed, thu, fri, sat, sun.

start.description: Start of a weekly mute, 24-hour HH:MM.

end.description: End of a weekly mute, 24-hour HH:MM; may wrap past midnight.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone the weekly window is read in, or "auto" for the process's own. Default auto.

muteSchedules.description: Planned mutes: one-off spans or weekly windows.

title.description: What the maintenance is, shown on the timeline.

startsAt.description: When the window opens, ISO 8601 with offset.

endsAt.description: When the window closes, ISO 8601 with offset; after startsAt.

maintenanceWindows.description: Maintenance you declare for this provider, treated as if its page had published it.

services.description: The providers to watch: at least one.

notifications.description: The channels changes are sent to, keyed by channel id.

provider.description: Which changes the rule matches: a service id, group:<slug>, tag:<slug>, <id>#<component>, or "*".

classes.description: Event classes matched: status, incident, maintenance, monitoring. Default all.

minSeverity.description: Lowest severity matched: any, degraded, partial_outage, major_outage. Default any.

channels.description: Channel ids to send to, "*" for every enabled channel, or [] to mute. Default ["*"].

routing.description: Ordered rules choosing which channels hear about a change; the first match wins. Absent sends everything everywhere.

enabled.description: Hold back changes below minSeverity during the window. Default false.

end.description: Window end, 24-hour HH:MM (exclusive); may wrap midnight. Default 07:00.

timeZone.description: IANA time zone the window is read in, or "auto" for the process's own. Default auto.

minSeverity.description: Severity that still gets through inside the window. Default major_outage.

quietHours.description: Hours when only serious changes get through.

enabled.description: Batch changes below immediateFloor into one message per window. Default false.

windowMinutes.description: Length of the digest window in minutes, 1–1440. Default 15.

immediateFloor.description: Severity sent at once instead of batched. Default major_outage.

digest.description: Batch non-urgent changes into one message per window.

enabled.description: Cap the messages per provider per rolling hour. Default false.

maxPerHour.description: Most changes per provider per hour, 1–1000. Default 10.

cap.description: A ceiling on messages per provider per hour.

updateInPlace.description: Edit one message per incident instead of sending one per update, where the channel can. Default false.

enabled.description: Announce a declared maintenance window before it opens. Default false.

leadMinutes.description: How long before the window to announce it, in minutes, 1–10080. Default 120.

maintenanceNotice.description: A heads-up before a declared maintenance window opens.

enabled.description: Resend an unacknowledged change on another channel. UI edition only. Default false.

afterMinutes.description: Minutes without acknowledgement before escalating, 1–1440. Default 15.

channel.description: The channel id the escalation goes to.

minSeverity.description: Lowest severity that escalates. Default major_outage.

escalation.description: Resend an unacknowledged change on another channel.

enabled.description: Tell the other channels when one keeps failing. Default false.

afterFailures.description: Failed messages in a row before saying so, 2–100. Default 3.

channelHealth.description: An alert when a channel keeps failing.

enabled.description: Replace the resolved messages of a shared failure with one summary. Default false.

incidentSummary.description: One summary when a shared failure ends.

enabled.description: Send only the latest of a run of updates to the same incident. Default false.

windowMinutes.description: How long an update waits for a newer one, in minutes, 1–60. Default 2.

coalesce.description: Collapse a run of updates to the same incident.

enabled.description: Batch further updates of an incident already in major outage into the digest. Default false.

knownOutage.description: Quiet updates during an outage already announced.

enabled.description: Send the fleet's weekly or monthly report. UI edition only. Default false.

channel.description: The channel id the report goes to.

report.description: A weekly or monthly fleet report on one channel.

enabled.description: Also notify whoever is on call this week. Default false.

minSeverity.description: Lowest severity the on-call person hears. Default major_outage.

rotation.description: Recipient ids taking turns, one per week (Monday to Sunday, UTC).

startsOn.description: Any day of the rotation's first week, YYYY-MM-DD.

onCall.description: A weekly on-call rotation of recipients.

enabled.description: Send every enabled channel a routine test message once a week. Default false.

deliveryTest.description: A weekly routine test message on every channel.

attachChart.description: Attach the provider's last 24 hours as an SVG chart, on email and webhook. UI edition only. Default false.

delivery.description: Quiet hours, digests, caps and the other delivery controls. All off by default.

id.description: Unique lowercase slug for this person, used in routing and on-call rotations.

channels.description: Channel ids in order of preference, at least two, each once.

recipients.description: People reached through several channels, preferred channel first.

allow.description: Private addresses, CIDR ranges or host names a probe may reach, on top of EGRESS_ALLOW.

egress.description: Egress policy: which private or loopback targets a probe may reach.

url.description: Pinged after every poll cycle that completed.

failUrl.description: Pinged instead after a cycle that failed.

method.description: HTTP method of the ping: GET or POST. Default GET.

heartbeat.description: IsItDown's own dead-man's switch: a URL pinged after every cycle.
